subject: delta(client): D11 keep the fixed reason when a chain reader rejects with a blank message
note: errorText keeps the fixed 'chain reader failed' text when a chain reader rejects with an empty or blank message, or one whose first 240 characters are blank; meaningful messages are returned unchanged and untrimmed. The host observation rejection table gains five rows, run on the domain, observation and closed-wallet routes. The commit recorded its change in the archive the package kept before the record files; this record states it in the record layout.
